description: This file defines functions and types for sending iMessage messages, including handling message options, media attachments, and message ID resolution. It exports the sendMessageIMessage function for sending messages via iMessage.

methods.name: stripUnsafeReplyTagChars
methods.description: Removes unsafe characters from reply tag IDs.

methods.name: sanitizeReplyToId
methods.description: Sanitizes and trims reply-to IDs, enforcing length limits.

methods.name: resolveMessageId
methods.description: Extracts message ID from various result object formats.

methods.name: resolveDeliveredIMessageText
methods.description: Returns message text or media placeholder based on MIME type.

methods.name: sendMessageIMessage
methods.description: Main function to send an iMessage with options for media, reply IDs, and target parsing.
